label: RT-AX89U AX6000 dual-band router (RT-AX89X firmware model string)
description: ASUS RT-AX89U - the model string this AX6000 board reports, which is the RT-AX89X hardware: Wi-Fi 6 AX6000 dual-band (2.4 GHz 4x4 1148 Mbps, 5 GHz 8x8 4804 Mbps), one 10GBASE-T RJ45 port, one 10G SFP+ cage, 1x 1G WAN, 8x 1G LAN and 2x USB 3.0. Commonly deployed as an AiMesh main router or node.
notes: `RT-AX89U` is not a second product: it is the board and firmware name behind the retail RT-AX89X, which is why a management integration reading the live device reports `Asus / RT-AX89U` and a topology labelled `RT-AX89X` is wrong about what is on the shelf. Three measurements, all public: ASUS ships the AX89X firmware as `FW_RT_AX89U_<build>` (an owner's flash log runs FW_RT_AX89U_300438647027 then FW_RT_AX89X_300438647468 on the same unit); Asuswrt-Merlin's `model.c` maps the hardware model string `RT-AX89U` to `MODEL_RTAX89U`; and the SWRT/GPL source for the AX89X builds as target `rt-ax89u`. The port map is therefore the AX89X's, cited from its technical-specification page - two SKU labels over one set of sockets, not two speculations.
